task: E17: two experts of one MoE package — does the noise band an expert specialises in change D1/D2?

geometry.vae: AutoencoderKLWan, z_dim 16 (same as Wan2.1, so no per-family normalisation change)

in_range_at_t600.why: t=600 => sigma 0.600 < 0.875, so the LOW-noise expert is the in-range one; the high-noise expert is run outside the band it was trained on (E17_PREREG.md §4.1)

probe.threads_note: the probe is not bit-reproducible across BLAS thread counts (E16); this run used 6, so its numbers are internally consistent but not bit-comparable to E8's 4-thread run at the 4th decimal

deviations.what: high-noise expert used at t=600 (out of range)
deviations.why: boundary_ratio 0.875 means it only runs above sigma 0.875
deviations.consequence: its AUC describes 'a 14B denoiser trained on another noise band', not its competence in its own regime

deviations.what: both experts share one random lower bound
deviations.why: identical architecture + identical init seed => bit-identical random weights (verified with torch.equal)
deviations.consequence: Q2's delta is real-side only: it is (delta real AUC)/(one shared denominator), so it carries less independent information than the pre-registration assumed

deviations.why: neither expert is measured inside its own noise band at the same t
deviations.consequence: a null result here means 'no detectable difference between the experts as tested', NOT 'noise-band specialisation does not affect readability'
